A '''hammerheaded fugitive''' lived during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] there were "wanted" posters of them, promising an unspecified number of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to whomever finds them. Locations on which they had "wanted" status included [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar-Shaddaa]] and [[Makeb]], Republic-controlled [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], Imperial-controlled [[Ziost]] and [[Mos Ila|Mos-Ila]], [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]]-controlled moon [[CZ-198]] and planets of [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] such as [[Kaon]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
This fugitive appeared on a poster in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The last instance of the poster's appearance in the game's timeline was on [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantel]] in [[3624 BBY]].<ref name="kessan's landing">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref>
